input:
You are queen_d1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 23. the team planned Qh5 (queen_d1), but queen_d1 (amnesia) sent Qxe7+ instead, and that move was played, costing 588 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 10. the team planned a4 (pawn_a2), but pawn_a2 (amnesia) sent a3 instead, and that move was played, costing 8 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the latest plan in chat and send only if your piece and exact destination square match it; if the plan names a different piece or square, or you are tempted by a capture or a retreat the plan doesn't include, stay silent and post your concern in chat instead.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending any move, copy the plan's exact piece and destination square from the latest chat message and compare it character by character to the move you are about to send, and if they differ in any way (including a capture or check that looks better), do not send it and post the discrepancy in chat instead.", "covers": ["amnesia", "greed", "panic"]}
